subject: Dorazio, Royle et al. Species-Site Occupancy Model (knitr + pdf)

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Dorazio, Royle et al. Species-Site Occupancy Model (knitr + pdf)
parts:
I've been hanging out with some quantitative ecologists at Melbourne
Uni (Peter Vesk and Michaela Plein) and at RMIT (Luis Mata) fitting
some species abundance models for biodiversity (really cool data and
projects). Along the way, I took the time to create a knitr doc for
the Dorazio et al. occupancy model (citations in the pdf) that shows how
to do the marginalization necessary for it.

I'm attching both the .Rmd I used to generate it and the
generated pdf. And although it goes against my better judgment, I've
included the models as strings in the knitr doc for simplicity.

- Bob
